language_note: Patterns summarize qualifying evidence; counts are not population prevalence. Direct-user reports remain anecdotal unless a controlled study measured them.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Fast time from first upload to a useful project view
user_delight_catalog.implication: Make the controlled plan register and first model state the first successful outcome.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: One project context shared across estimating, delivery and customer workflows
user_delight_catalog.implication: Keep a persistent project rail and one server-side project identifier.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Field access on phones and tablets
user_delight_catalog.implication: Use large reachable controls, internal scrolling and a compact mobile tool dock.
Use inspectable 3D linked to plan evidence.
Keep projects, stages, layers and records easy to locate.
Accept related sheets together and report one atomic project outcome.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Plan viewing and markup near field records
user_delight_catalog.implication: Keep source sheets reachable from selected objects and workflow records.
Always show units and distinguish model measurements from written controls.
Preserve safe preferences and never report unsynced writes as saved.
Expose owner, status, due date and history.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Timely notifications tied to a clear action
user_delight_catalog.implication: Make alerts actionable and traceable to the project record.
Integrate only when failure and ownership are visible.
Keep construction-stage defaults editable without cloning unrelated data.
Link visible stages to actual objects and source tasks.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Photo evidence organized by place and purpose
user_delight_catalog.implication: Persist image evidence on the owning project/record.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Daily field records that are quick to complete
user_delight_catalog.implication: Use short forms, sensible defaults and a durable audit trail.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Undo, retry and recovery instead of punishment
user_delight_catalog.implication: Preserve work, use idempotency and explain the safe next action.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Revision history and clear controlling plans
user_delight_catalog.implication: Inventory every sheet, revision and superseded state.
Keep source files and structured evidence portable.
Attach source sheet/detail and evidence state to significant objects.
Use honest loading, success and error states with incident IDs.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Responsive layouts that keep controls visible
user_delight_catalog.implication: Bind the workspace to the viewport and scroll only intentional panels.
Provide semantic tool buttons, focus containment and a nonvisual object register.
Expose synchronized layers and an underground isolation mode.
Make cutaway/section controls stable and resettable.
Use exactly 12 object-driven stages with cumulative/current modes.
Record agency, record, retrieval date, CRS and confidence.
Show existing/proposed grades without undisclosed exaggeration.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: Professional presentation that remains technically honest
user_delight_catalog.implication: Pair realistic/technical views with visible uncertainty.

user_delight_catalog.pattern: AI assistance that accelerates review without replacing judgment
user_delight_catalog.implication: Keep AI output reviewable, source-linked and explicitly non-authoritative.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Slow, complex onboarding before a first useful result
user_pain_catalog.implication: Minimize setup and show a controlled result early.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Too many menus and modules with unclear starting points
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use progressive disclosure and task-oriented labels.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Decorative dashboards whose controls do not complete work
user_pain_catalog.implication: Remove dead controls and test every visible action.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Mobile model viewer loads blank
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide loading/failure states and a nonvisual fallback.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Large models run slowly or freeze
user_pain_catalog.implication: Cap DPR/geometry and release GPU resources.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Viewer loses the model or traps the camera
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide stable fit/reset and bounded controls.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Uploads fail without explaining which file caused it
user_pain_catalog.implication: Validate per file and return an actionable message.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Refresh loses upload or viewer progress
user_pain_catalog.implication: Persist critical state and keep retries idempotent.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Duplicate clicks create duplicate projects or side effects
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use server-side idempotency keys.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Silent sync conflicts overwrite newer work
user_pain_catalog.implication: Detect conflicts and never silently overwrite.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Plan revisions are hard to identify
user_pain_catalog.implication: Show revision, approval and superseded status.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Missing sheet inventory hides scope
user_pain_catalog.implication: Register every supplied sheet before modeling.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: One-click AI quantities look precise but are wrong
user_pain_catalog.implication: Require human verification and written-dimension controls.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Model geometry is not traceable to drawings
user_pain_catalog.implication: Store object provenance and ambiguity.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Inferred geometry looks identical to verified geometry
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use visible and textual evidence states.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: 4D sequence is an animation with no task/object linkage
user_pain_catalog.implication: Drive visibility from stage metadata.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Underground systems are hidden by terrain/building
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide x-ray, cutaway and underground-only modes.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Detailed utility routes are invented where plans are schematic
user_pain_catalog.implication: Represent zones or mark not shown.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: GIS boundaries are treated as survey accuracy
user_pain_catalog.implication: Display agency caveats and keep legal-layout gate closed.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Parcel IDs and lot areas conflict across sources
user_pain_catalog.implication: Show the conflict until authoritative reconciliation.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Road frontage is confused with pavement or ROW
user_pain_catalog.implication: Model distinct line types and verify the frontage intersection.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Adjacent owner names substitute for parcel IDs
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use sourced APNs or 'Parcel ID unavailable'.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Terrain exaggeration is undisclosed
user_pain_catalog.implication: Default true scale and label any exaggeration.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Section/clipping controls are difficult to reset
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide a stable reset path.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Floating panels become lost offscreen
user_pain_catalog.implication: Dock/clamp panels and provide Reset Layout.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Nested scrolling traps users
user_pain_catalog.implication: Keep page scrolling disabled and panel scrolling intentional.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Controls run offscreen at high zoom
user_pain_catalog.implication: Reflow the shell and use scrollable tool rails.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Tiny touch targets fail in field use
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use reachable, labeled touch controls.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Keyboard focus disappears or escapes dialogs
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use visible focus and focus containment.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Canvas-only data excludes screen-reader users
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide a structured object/provenance table.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Color alone communicates verification
user_pain_catalog.implication: Pair color with explicit status text.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Error messages expose internals or offer no recovery
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use safe copy, incident IDs and retry guidance.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: False success is shown before storage commits
user_pain_catalog.implication: Confirm D1/R2 persistence first.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Authentication fallback merges unrelated customers
user_pain_catalog.implication: Fail closed without identity.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Client-only authorization permits direct-object access
user_pain_catalog.implication: Enforce workspace ownership in every server query.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Cross-site mutation requests are accepted
user_pain_catalog.implication: Verify same-origin intent.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Uploaded file type is trusted from its extension
user_pain_catalog.implication: Validate MIME, extension and signature.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Predictable storage keys expose private plans
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use opaque workspace/project/file keys.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Partial R2/D1 writes leave orphan projects
user_pain_catalog.implication: Use compensation, transaction boundaries and reconciliation.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Failures cannot be correlated by operators
user_pain_catalog.implication: Emit privacy-safe incident IDs and structured context.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Logs collect plan contents or private values
user_pain_catalog.implication: Log identifiers and failure class, not document content.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Integration failures disappear
user_pain_catalog.implication: Surface integration state and retry ownership.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Notification noise obscures critical actions
user_pain_catalog.implication: Tie notifications to severity and next action.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Pricing limits or fees surprise users
user_pain_catalog.implication: State scope/limits before the user commits time.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Exports are incomplete or trap data
user_pain_catalog.implication: Provide documented portable outputs.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Templates carry stale data into a new project
user_pain_catalog.implication: Separate reusable structure from project evidence.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Team permissions are unclear
user_pain_catalog.implication: Show role and scope; default secondary viewers to least privilege.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: No rollback exists after a bad release
user_pain_catalog.implication: Maintain immutable versions and exact rollback steps.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: Health checks report app uptime while dependencies fail
user_pain_catalog.implication: Check critical dependency health.

user_pain_catalog.pattern: A passing build is mistaken for a passing user journey
user_pain_catalog.implication: Require rendered critical-path and failure passes.

trust_killer_catalog.pattern: Invented plan, parcel, utility or dimensional data
trust_killer_catalog.implication: Block field use and label unresolved.

trust_killer_catalog.pattern: False success after a failed or partial save
Cross-customer access or fallback identity
trust_killer_catalog.implication: Fail closed and isolate every query.

trust_killer_catalog.pattern: A 2.5D preview labeled a digital twin
trust_killer_catalog.implication: Use real 3D and honest maturity labels.

trust_killer_catalog.pattern: Legal-survey language applied to GIS reference data
Unexplained AI certainty
Plans uploaded but missing after refresh
Duplicate house/project creation
Unannounced revision mismatch
Viewer controls that do nothing
Critical tools hidden offscreen
Errors that blame the user but offer no recovery
trust_killer_catalog.implication: Explain failure and safe next step.

trust_killer_catalog.pattern: Sensitive plan data in logs or predictable URLs
Permissions that exist only in the interface
Parcel/APN conflict silently resolved by assumption
Detailed MEP routing invented from schematic plans
No way to recover a lost camera or layout
Unmonitored production failure
No credible rollback after release
Affiliate/vendor claims presented as independent user truth

research_limitations: Ninety-five qualifying sources have no retained exact publication/update date and are excluded from recency quotas.
Public reviews and community reports overrepresent motivated users and do not establish prevalence.
Vendor documentation verifies product behavior, not user sentiment or outcomes.
Commercial comparisons may contain affiliate incentives and receive reduced credibility scores.
No representative Builder Assist usability study was run in this environment; satisfaction remains unverified.
The official parcel record endpoint blocked full content retrieval, so parcel reconciliation remains a launch blocker.
